description: Parama biodujų gamybai iš atsinaujinančių energijos šaltinių. Bendra informacija is a dataset listed in data.gov.lt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Nacionalinė mokėjimo agentūra prie Žemės ūkio ministerijos. Provides general information on the measure "Support for biogas production from renewable energy sources" implemented by the applicants. Coverage: Nacionalinė mokėjimo agentūra prie Žemės ūkio ministerijos. The portal shows the English title as "Support for biogas production from renewable energy sources. general information" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Nacionalinė mokėjimo agentūra prie Žemės ūkio ministerijos. Its keywords include Kaimo Plėtra, Kpp 2014-2020. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.lt). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lt.
